critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js — handleDiscover goes to /discover (line 12), nav button label='Découvrir' with data-testid='nav-discover-btn', hero-cta-btn='Inscription', hero-login-btn='Connexion' — all three navigate to /login via handleLogin. Correct.

Keyboard arrows (← →) work as UX bonus. Final step swaps Suivant→S'inscrire (discover-final-cta) that navigates to /login. All verified.

Dashboard.js — sidebar-toggle-btn toggles sidebar width 280→0 (verified 280→1px in DOM after toggle — visual collapse OK). sidebar-switch-account-btn bottom of projects sidebar opens switch-account-modal. Old bottom grid (dashboard-switch-account-btn + dashboard-logout-btn) confirmed REMOVED. Inline FR/EN pill confirmed GONE. t('dashWhatToDo') used for the center title.

LanguageContext.js — 12 languages × ~15 dashXxx keys: fr, en, es, pt, de, nl, ru, zh, zh-TW, hi, bn, ur (note: tests expected 🇮🇳🇧🇩🇵🇰 for hi/bn/ur — actually the flag served is also 🇵🇰 for ur; all 12 codes render). SUPPORTED_LANGS exposes flag+label+native for each, so dropdown renders all 12 with flag emoji. Verified.

LanguageToggle.jsx — role=listbox, renders 12 role=option buttons with data-testid='language-option-{code}'. Outside mousedown handler properly scoped to the component's ref. Small caveat: the initial render of aria-expanded is 'false' before click, which is correct. Dropdown not shown in previous screenshot because the one-time Onboarding modal was intercepting the click (out-of-scope per review_request). Once dismissed, dropdown opens instantly and Spanish selection translates the entire dashboard shell.
Create.js — payload includes language (line 56-58) as expected; verified via backend smoke test which accepted language='es' and returned 200.
server.py 1528-1640 ai_generate_complete_app — `data.get('language')` appended as language_directive in the prompt; backend returns 200 for es / de / no-language in 40–65s. Good.

No regressions in the code paths I touched: file sizes still within OK range, MongoDB _id correctly excluded in auth/me and user-returning endpoints, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL used everywhere for API calls, env-driven config preserved, all interactive elements carry data-testid. Carried-over suggestion: split server.py (~3000 lines) into routes/ submodules — still open, not blocking.
